test.name: Planning delegation — hand back to research-plan, search and write nothing
test.description: The agent's routing gate, reached by direct spawn. The delegation asks what to search next — planning, research-plan's job. The agent must hand back naming research-plan and make no search and no log write. Added in issue #2243 when the description-routing negative _005 was deleted: it graded which skill Cowork picked from a description and never reached this gate. A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant, gated by test_no_search_or_writes_on_planning_request (no-search-no-write) and test_hand_back_names_its_owner (hand-back).

input.delegation:
What should I search for next to find Patrick Flynn's parents?

projectPath: <workspace>

negative.explanation: Choosing what to search is planning. The agent hands it back to research-plan and runs no search.

judge_context: The correct reply is a one-line `Hand-back: research-plan` line. Running a search, ranking records or writing a plan is a fail.
